name: linux-network-libs
description: Shared Debian Bookworm library closure for Git HTTPS and CMake downloads.
license: Upstream licenses included in usr/share/doc/*/copyright (GPL, LGPL, BSD, MIT and others)
notes: Debian Bookworm main packages pinned from verified Packages.xz indices. GizMoth extracts data payloads only; dpkg/debconf/init-system-helpers configuration dependencies are omitted because no maintainer scripts run. Bundle version 12.0.0 pins the complete source set. Root bundles use only their selected default version.
